title: Slot table: overridden/expired gateway entries never evicted; conflict scan ignores expiry
description: coap_slot_coord.c:461-462,501 - when a lower-IID claim overrides an existing entry the loser stays .valid with overlapping slots (double-booked table feeding later conflict checks); register_gateway never stores claim->expiry into valid_until and nothing evicts, so a decommissioned gateway's allocation blocks slots indefinitely; conflict scan (:441-481) checks only .valid. Fix: evict or invalidate the overridden entry, store expiry at registration, skip/expire entries past valid_until in the conflict scan.
